name: Data-Plane Security Group Pivot
description: Security groups are the firewall around databases and load balancers. Opening them to the internet, or to a wide internal range, lets the attacker reach data they could not reach from the control plane. This is not changing IAM. It is opening a network path to RDS, Elasticsearch, or a load balancer. Once the port is open they can brute-force, use stolen DB passwords, or scrape traffic. Security-group rules that suddenly allow 0.0.0.0/0 on data ports are the classic tell.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
